data.summary:
Backend Engineering Professional with over 6 years of experience in architecting scalable, resilient, & high- performance server-side systems across cloud-native environments.
Currently working as a Senior Software Engineer with Lognormal.io (OVO Energy), and previously as a Senior Software Engineer at Zentrades, Pune, leading end-to-end back-end development, technical design, and delivery of enterprise-grade solutions.
Skilled in Node.js, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, and Python (working knowledge), with proven expertise in API development, microservices implementation, and enterprise integrations.
Showcased success in cloud infrastructure optimization on AWS (EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, Auto Scaling), ensuring cost efficiency, scalability, and fault tolerance.
Played a key role in architecture modernization, including transitioning monolithic systems to Microservices and executing seamless database migrations.
Recognized for leading a team of 16 developers and 4 QA engineers, driving sprint planning, feature prioritization, and stakeholder alignment for mission-critical projects.
Strong track record of improving system reliability, reducing outages, and enhancing performance metrics through proactive monitoring, observability platforms, and optimization.

raw_sections.experience:
Targeting Senior Backend Developer roles with 
WORK EXPERIENCE
Lognormal.io (OVO Energy) | Senior Software Engineer | Nov 2025 – Present ● Working across a UK energy client's government rebate and customer-support schemes, spanning a Scala
service, a TypeScript monorepo, Terraform infrastructure, and GitOps-based deployments.
Resolved a payment-reporting defect ahead of an external audit by tracing flagged cases to reporting artifacts rather than real duplicate payments, and corrected the logic for a previously unaccounted-for payment channel.
Extended and backfilled production data models across ~65,000 records with zero data-integrity mismatches, making previously unreportable customer data complete and joinable.
Designed and executed a controlled pause and resume of a live third-party integration, draining a backlog of ~5,000 queued records and hardening the batch job after a mid-run infrastructure failure.
Authored technical analyses behind architecture and scheme decisions, presenting options, trade-offs, and recommendations backed by supporting evidence.
Zentrades, Pune | Senior Software Engineer | Jul 2020 – Jul 2025 Growth Path: SDE 4 (Senior Software Engineer) | Mar 2023 – Jul 2025 SDE 3 | Jul 2021 – Feb 2023 SDE 1 | Jul 2020 – Jun 2021
Directed collaboration with 20+ engineers and stakeholders, driving sprint planning and project execution. ● Supervised end-to-end implementation of enterprise solutions including AI agents, client portals, and ACL- based systems.
Implemented observability with Nagios, Winston, and CloudWatch, improving incident detection and resolution.
Deployed high-availability infrastructure using Node.js clusters, PM2, and Nginx, boosting system reliability. ● Executed MongoDB-to-MySQL migration and Monolith-to-Microservices transition, enabling scalability.
